=== enter between braces
--- before
func main() {¦}
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
func main() {
	¦
}

=== electric closer
--- before
func f() {
	x()
	¦
--- keys
}
--- after
func f() {
	x()
}¦

=== tabs indent
--- before
func f() {
	if x {¦}
}
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
func f() {
	if x {
		¦
	}
}

=== autoclose
--- before
x := ¦
--- keys
[]int{1
--- after
x := []int{1¦}

=== backtick string
--- before
s := ¦
--- keys
`a
--- after
s := `a¦`

=== surround
--- before
x := «y»
--- keys
(
--- after
x := («y»)

=== line comment
--- before
«x := 1
y := 2»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«// x := 1
// y := 2»

=== line comment off
--- before
«// x := 1
// y := 2»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«x := 1
y := 2»

=== no autoclose in string
--- before
s := "a¦"
--- keys
{
--- after
s := "a{¦"

=== backspace pair
--- before
f¦
--- keys
(<bs>
--- after
f¦
